{{Quote|Rescue workers have been working around the clock to reach some 4,000 passengers and workers who were trapped in a monorail traveling through the Pica Rim Pipeline alter a series of bombs ruptured a 4,000 kilometer section of the undersea transit tube.|A [[Colonial News Nets]] report|<ref name="GNN10" />}}
An '''attack''' on the [[Pica Rim Pipeline]] took place in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Albrae-Don/Legends|Albrae-Don]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The terrorist group [[Justice Action Network]] [[Bomb/Legends|bombed]] the [[Pica Rim Pipeline]], a large [[Water/Legends|underwater]] transportation system that lined the floors of the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], in protest of the execution of its leader: [[Earnst Kamiel]]. A series of bombs ruptured and flooded a 4,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] section of the structure. Some 4,000 passengers were trapped in a [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] traveling through the Pipeline. Rescue workers were sent to save them but they were difficult to reach and the monorail was not designed to withstand the pressure of tons of water, making the passengers' situation critical.

==Behind the scenes==
The bombing of the Pica Rim Pipeline was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]], which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and published in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="GNN10" />
